title: anchor_subjects silently drops anchors whose subject DER fails
description: In build_chain(), anchor_subjects is built with filter_map(|a| a.tbs_certificate().subject().to_der().ok()). If any trust anchor certificate fails to DER-encode its subject (corrupt or unusual anchor), that anchor is silently dropped from the set. The loop will then fail to terminate at that anchor, continue looking for an intermediate in the bag, and return NoMatchingIssuer rather than surfacing the anchor encoding failure. This can cause spurious chain failures with a misleading error.
